locations.name: Materials Yard
locations.apprentice: Gain 3 resources in any combination of Clay and Wood.
locations.apprenticeZh: 获得共3份泥和/或柴，可任意组合。
locations.shifu: Gain 4 resources in any combination of Clay and Wood. Then you may pay 1 Coin to gain +1 Clay and +1 Wood.
locations.shifuZh: 获得共4份泥和/或柴，可任意组合。然后可支付1铜钱，额外获得1泥和1柴。

locations.name: Potter’s Wheel
locations.apprentice: Pay the Clay cost to form 1 vessel.
locations.apprenticeZh: 支付泥费用，成型1件器物。
locations.shifu: Form up to 2 vessels, each starting Plain for free. If you form 2, reduce their total Clay cost by 1.
locations.shifuZh: 成型最多2件器物，均免费获得素面。若成型2件，泥总费用减少1。

locations.name: Decoration Workshop
locations.apprentice: Replace Plain with Carved, Impressed or Painted on 1 of your workshop ceramics; pay 2 Coins.
locations.apprenticeZh: 将作坊内1件素面器物改为刻花、印花或彩绘，支付2铜钱。
locations.shifu: Replace Plain with Carved, Impressed or Painted on up to 2 of your workshop ceramics. One Decoration is free; pay 2 Coins for the other before waivers.
locations.shifuZh: 将作坊内最多2件素面器物改为刻花、印花或彩绘。其中1件纹饰免费，另一件在减免前支付2铜钱。

locations.name: Kiln Yard
locations.apprentice: Pay 1 Coin to glaze and immediately load 1 of your workshop ceramics.
locations.apprenticeZh: 支付1铜钱，为作坊内1件器物施釉并立即装窑。
locations.shifu: Pay 1 Coin each to glaze and immediately load up to 2 workshop ceramics. Place your Shifu on 1 ceramic loaded by this action in either kiln. After Base Heat, before Fire, optionally replace it with a +1 or −1 Heat marker at no Wood cost.
locations.shifuZh: 每件支付1铜钱，为作坊内最多2件器物施釉并立即装窑。将师傅放在本次行动装入共窑或御窑的1件陶瓷上。基础火候确定后、揭示窑火前，可免费将师傅替换为+1或−1火候标记。

locations.name: Commission Market
locations.apprentice: Reserve 1 Main Order. Then gain 1 Clay, 1 Wood or 1 Coin.
locations.apprenticeZh: 承接1张主委托。然后获得1泥、1柴或1铜钱。
locations.shifu: Reserve up to 2 Main Orders, resolving each reservation separately. After each reservation, gain 1 Clay, 1 Wood or 1 Coin.
locations.shifuZh: 最多承接2张主委托，逐张独立结算。每承接1张后，获得1泥、1柴或1铜钱。

locations.name: Craft Academy
locations.apprentice: Pay the printed Coin cost and take 1 face-up Advanced Tech.
locations.apprenticeZh: 支付牌面铜钱费用，取得1个公开进阶技艺。
locations.shifu: Choose 1 discipline and privately inspect its top 2 Techs, or as many as remain. Take 1 face-up Advanced Tech from any discipline or 1 inspected Tech, paying 1 Coin less, minimum 0. Return unchosen inspected Techs to the bottom in your chosen order.
locations.shifuZh: 选择1个类别，私下查看该叠顶端2个技艺（不足则尽量查看）。取得任意类别的1个公开技艺或其中1个已查看技艺，支付费用减1铜钱，最低为0。自行决定未取得的已查看技艺顺序，并放到该叠底。

locations.name: Imperial Court
locations.apprentice: Pay 5 Coins to advance Recognition by 1, up to space 3 only. Resolve the milestone normally.
locations.apprenticeZh: 支付5铜钱，御府声望提升1格，最高到第3格，正常结算奖励。
locations.shifu: Pay 5 Coins to advance Recognition by 1, up to space 3 only. Resolve the milestone normally.
locations.shifuZh: 支付5铜钱，御府声望提升1格，最高到第3格，正常结算奖励。
